display.purpose: Headlines, CTAs, and anything the page asserts.

wordmark.purpose: The personal name mark only, centered in the header, set in caps. Free geometric-sans match for a brief-pinned Futura PT Medium reference.

motion.name: reveal-emergence
motion.value: opacity 1.1s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), filter 1.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 1.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)
motion.purpose: Chemical-emergence reveal for media entering the viewport; from brightness(0.15) blur(2px) scale(1.015) to clear. Media only, never typography.

motion.name: beam-drift
motion.purpose: Slow drift of the jade radial gradient standing in for a projector beam on reel-plate placeholders.

motion.name: scanline-flicker
motion.purpose: Low-opacity flicker on the reel-plate scanline texture.

motion.name: cta-hover
motion.purpose: Primary button scales 1.03 and its arrow icon shifts right on hover.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.value: Lenis, duration 1.4s, quart-out easing, wheelMultiplier 0.85, site-wide via the layout, skipped under prefers-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: A heavier, eased momentum scroll in place of native scroll, matching the register of theartofdocumentary.com.

motion.name: reveal-text
motion.purpose: Quieter heading-only sibling of reveal-emergence: no blur or brightness ramp, used for standalone statement headlines like the homepage's 'story brought to life' line.

motion.name: hero-reel-parallax
motion.value: translateY(scrollY * 0.2) applied only to the reel, while the heading/sub/CTA stay in normal flow at native scroll speed; skipped under prefers-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Dissociates the homepage hero's text from its background reel as the visitor scrolls, matching theartofdocumentary.com's own scroll-tied hero video.

motion.name: link-sweep
motion.value: 1px currentColor rule, transform: scaleX(0) with transform-origin right bottom at rest, scaleX(1) with transform-origin left bottom on hover, 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1)
motion.purpose: Footer link hover: sweeps in from the left, exits to the right on mouse-out rather than shrinking back — matches theartofdocumentary.com's own footer link underline exactly.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The system's only CTA treatment — used for every 'Book a call' instance.
components.html: Book a call
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #45b892; color: #050504; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.04em; font-size: 1.125rem; padding: 16px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-arrow { transition: transform 0.3s ease; }

components.name: Menu Toggle
components.description: Header icon button; two bars that rotate into an X when the takeover menu opens.
components.css: .ds-menu-toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; } .ds-menu-bars { position: relative; display: block; width: 24px; height: 14px; } .ds-bar { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 1.5px; background: #f3f1ea; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-bar:first-child { top: 0; } .ds-bar:last-child { bottom: 0; } .ds-menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-bar:first-child { transform: translateY(6px) rotate(45deg); } .ds-menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-bar:last-child { transform: translateY(-6px) rotate(-45deg); }

components.name: Reel Plate
components.description: Placeholder-footage treatment: projector-beam glow, scanline flicker, and film grain, standing in for real video or photography until it exists.
components.html: CommercialFootage coming soon
components.css: .ds-reel-plate { position: relative; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: #050504; } .ds-reel-plate::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -35%; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 45% 40% at 32% 38%, rgba(69,184,146,0.24) 0%, transparent 62%); animation: ds-beam-drift 9s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-reel-plate::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(243,241,234,0.04) 0px, transparent 1px, transparent 3px); opacity: 0.5; } @keyframes ds-beam-drift { 0%, 100% { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translate(18%,14%) scale(1.15); } } .ds-reel-play { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; opacity: 0.2; } .ds-reel-label { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.04em; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #948f84; }

components.name: Takeover Menu Link
components.description: One link row inside the full-screen navigation takeover; huge display type, jade when current.
components.css: .ds-menu-link { display: block; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.04em; font-size: 9vw; color: #f3f1ea; transition: color 0.3s ease; } .ds-menu-link:hover { color: #45b892; } .ds-menu-link--current { color: #45b892; }

narrative.overview: The site is built as a screening room, not a brochure: near-total darkness, one beam of light, and footage that plays itself before a single word of pitch is made. It was grounded directly in two references the client pinned — dannygevirtz.com/dannysprojects (a full-bleed, self-playing 3x3 film grid) and theartofdocumentary.com (a black-ground, amber-accented persuasion page with a pinned scroll passage and a full-screen takeover menu) — translated to Quentin's own positioning: work built from genuinely understanding a client before a camera is ever raised. The accent itself moved on from that reference's amber to a jade green, explored later as its own direction and kept.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground throughout, lit only by a drifting jade beam and film grain
One accent color, spent only on the primary action and current-state emphasis
Full-bleed, edge-to-edge media wherever footage or its placeholder appears — never inside a card
A single authored motion signature (media developing into clarity) reserved for media, never for typography
Navigation lives entirely inside a full-screen black takeover, never a persistent link row

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Jade appears at most once per viewport — the single action or single emphasis the visitor should notice.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No heading anywhere carries a small label above it.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from light and grain, never a drop shadow.

rules.name: The Two-Radius Rule
rules.body: An element is either sharp (0px) or a full pill (9999px). Nothing in between.

dos: Do reserve jade for exactly one thing per viewport: the primary action or the current-state signal.
Do use the reel-plate treatment — never a gray box, skeleton, or stock photo — for anything standing in for footage that doesn't exist yet.
Do apply the chemical-emergence reveal only to media entering the viewport, never to headings or paragraphs.
Do keep every clickable pill fully rounded and every structural element sharp — no radius in between.
Do give the header its gradient scrim on every page, so it stays legible over the hero media it opens on.
donts: Don't add a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading, anywhere, for any reason.
Don't add a box-shadow to anything. Depth is beam glow and grain, never a drop shadow.
Don't introduce a second accent color alongside jade, even a muted one.
Don't build page structure from same-size icon+heading+text cards.
Don't fabricate a testimonial, client name, or credit in a placeholder slot — an honest 'coming soon' label beats a fictional one.
